item.title: Cats 2
item.media:title: Cats 2
item.media:description:
Have some more cats, because they're fun to paint :3

And a thought accompanying this:
I have an intense dislike of the idea of humans breeding animals. Yet I can't help but admire the sheer variety and beauty of some human-created breeds. And that's one of the dilemmas you're facing when you're an animal activist and an artist at the same time.

I think the only solution is to place this kind of artwork into a context or a story or make the image tell something by itself (which this one doesn't, so I'm writing a text to go with it). I don't just want to create beautiful-looking art in a vacuum, I want to communicate something to the world about the world.

Did any of you have similar thoughts at any point with your own art, even with different subjects? Ethical dilemmas like this come up ALL THE TIME in my artist life. From accepting client jobs to scrolling my feed to something as simple as posting a cute cat pic on the internet. I'd love to hear other people's thoughts.
